changelog: Turn a public TikTok stitch target into one quote reply card per chosen hook.

en.description: Turn a public TikTok stitch target into one quote reply card per chosen hook. This stitch prompt card studio reads the quoted video and comments, then makes quote reply stills from the reply lines you already wrote. Use it for quote reply cards, stitch prompt cards, and TikTok quote reply stills.
en.summary: Turn a public TikTok stitch target into one quote reply card per chosen hook.
en.title: Stitch Prompt Card: One Quote Reply Still Per Hook
